items.t: Backup camera goes blank or says unavailable (recall)
items.job: Install updated infotainment and camera software (recall 25V-615)

items.t: Center screen freezes, goes black or reboots
items.job: Diagnose and reload or update infotainment software
items.note: Owners report these repairs were done free; the new-car warranty is 4 years/50,000 miles. A head unit replacement out of warranty costs much more.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains and car goes dead
items.job: Replace 12-volt AGM battery and reset systems
items.note: The car uses an H6-size AGM 12-volt battery. Price range is KBB's general battery range; AGM batteries sit at the top of it.

items.t: Propulsion system service required and loss of power
items.job: Read fault codes and install drive-system software update
items.note: Covered under the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage battery warranty or 4-year/50,000-mile new-car warranty in most cases. Hardware repairs cost more.

items.t: Battery control module reset cuts drive power (recall)
items.job: Update battery energy control module software (recall 21V-110)

items.t: Car locks itself or won't recognize the key
items.job: Diagnose keyless system, test 12-volt battery, update software
items.note: If the 12-volt battery or TCAM module is the cause, add that part's cost.

items.t: Car brakes hard by itself when reversing or parking
items.job: Check rear sensors and update driver-assist software
items.note: Usually a software or calibration fix covered under warranty.

items.t: Lane keeping or Pilot Assist steers unexpectedly
items.job: Calibrate front camera and update driver-assist software

items.t: Charging stops early or won't start
items.job: Diagnose charging system and update software
items.note: Parts such as the charge port or onboard charger cost extra if they are at fault.

items.t: Front lower ball joint may be installed wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace ball joint fastening bolt (recall 23V-476)

items.t: Driver far-side airbag may not deploy right (recall)
items.job: Replace driver inner far-side airbag module (recall 24V-939)
